fixes.explanation: You got it, baker, the word is burned. The text says, "A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass." That's what happens when the first angel sounds his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood are hurled down upon the earth. I've burned a batch or two myself, but never a third of the earth.
